mapper.sql: select d.declare_id, d.person_id, d.declare_type, d.declare_year, d.declare_date, d.status, d.verify_by, d.verify_time, d.verify_result, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time, d.remark, p.name as person_name, p.dept_path as person_dept from jc_conflict_declare d left join jc_person p on p.person_id = d.person_id and p.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where d.person_id = #{personId} and d.del_flag = '0' order by d.declare_year desc, d.declare_id desc
mapper.update: update jc_conflict_declare set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where declare_id = #{declareId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from jc_conflict_declare where del_flag = '0' and declare_year = #{year}
select status as name, count(*) as value from jc_conflict_declare where del_flag = '0' and declare_year = #{year} group by status order by value desc
select declare_type as name, count(*) as value from jc_conflict_declare where del_flag = '0' and declare_year = #{year} group by declare_type order by value desc
select date_format(coalesce(declare_date, create_time), '%Y-%m') as name, count(*) as value from jc_conflict_declare where del_flag = '0' and declare_year = #{year} group by name order by name

select count(distinct d.declare_id) from jc_conflict_declare d join jc_conflict_item i on i.declare_id = d.declare_id and i.del_flag = '0' and i.is_conflict = '1' where d.del_flag = '0' and d.declare_year = #{year}

select count(distinct i.item_id) from jc_conflict_declare d join jc_conflict_item i on i.declare_id = d.declare_id and i.del_flag = '0' join jc_supplier s on s.del_flag = '0' and s.status in ('3', '4') and (s.credit_code = i.ent_credit_code or s.supplier_name = i.ent_name) where d.del_flag = '0' and d.declare_year = #{year}

select person_id, person_code, name, dept_id, dept_path, position, status, risk_level from jc_person p where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '在岗' and not exists ( select 1 from jc_conflict_declare d where d.person_id = p.person_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.declare_year = #{year} ) order by p.dept_id, p.person_id

select p.name as personName, p.dept_path as personDept, count(distinct d.declare_id) as declareCount, count(distinct i.item_id) as itemCount, count(distinct case when i.is_conflict = '1' then i.item_id end) as conflictItems from jc_conflict_declare d join jc_person p on p.person_id = d.person_id and p.del_flag = '0' left join jc_conflict_item i on i.declare_id = d.declare_id and i.del_flag = '0' where d.del_flag = '0' and d.declare_year = #{year} group by p.person_id, p.name, p.dept_path order by conflictItems desc, declareCount desc limit 10
where d.del_flag = '0' and d.declare_year = #{year} order by d.declare_id desc
